mathematics.assertion_tested: 163 deterministic recoil quadratures, conservation checks, rate-cancellation and lifetime-probability integrals, and jump-versus-diffusion moment comparisons.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE float64 with SciPy adaptive quadrature and central finite differences.
mathematics.conventions: Cold source at rest, isotropic COM Born contact, off-resonant kinetic energy E=z*delta. Constant-rate subsection explicitly freezes rate only as a diagnostic.
non_claims: No proof of a Markov reduction, physical source state, or measured collision rate.
Small density proxy is a specified regime, not a universal necessity for arbitrary quantum source states.
Source decay treated as unreplenished exponential dilution for first-event diagnostic.
No microscopic halo selection or irreversible closed-system kinetic energy sink.
